what_was_done: All five leaks, in the hand-written region (the scans run on js, the body with comments and string contents blanked): (a) RUN_SUBSCRIPT_RE ('RUN[') and OBJECT_ASSIGN_RUN_RE ('Object.assign(RUN') are violations in themselves, so RUN['tier'] = 'reviewer' and Object.assign(RUN, { tier: TIER.reviewer }) - the forms the assignment scan cannot see, which matches only the spelling RUN.tier - are rejected. (b) TIER_NAME_RE is now scanned over the whole hand-written region: any naming of TIER, ROLE or OVERRIDE is a tier setting, which closes the alias form 'const x = TIER' followed by 'RUN.tier = x.reviewer || null' (the adoption form still admits the dotted chain, so the reference was the only door). (c) HANDWRITTEN_TIER_KEY_RE rejects every tier: object key in the hand-written region - the two adoption forms carry no object key - so a hand-written workflow('vsdd-factory:story', { story: id, tier: TIER.reviewer }) is rejected, with a table reference as without one. (d) TIER_KEY_RE now rejects a model: or effort: value that holds a quoted literal anywhere before the value's next , or } - { model: big ? 'opus' : 'sonnet' } again - while a carried value ({ model: u.model, effort: u.effort, and the ternary with carried branches }) still passes. And _strip_comments_and_strings ends a ' or " string at an unescaped newline (JavaScript allows no string to span lines; a template literal still does), so a / it misreads - if (x) /'/.test(y), where the / after ')' is division and the quote then opens a string, or a++ / 2; const s = 'x/y', where the / after '+' is read as a regex swallowing to the / in x/y - can no longer leave an unterminated string that blanks the rest of the file and hides a later direct agent( call: the lint no longer fails open. Five new tests, one per form plus the stripper's two misreads, each run against a reverted scratch copy of the lint first and there failing as it must, then passing with the fix: test_a_subscripted_or_merged_tier_write_is_rejected, test_an_alias_of_the_tier_table_is_rejected, test_a_hand_written_tier_key_is_rejected, test_a_model_chosen_between_literals_is_rejected, test_an_unterminated_quote_hides_nothing_after_it. The skeletons and the toys read no TIER, ROLE or OVERRIDE in their hand-written regions, so the stricter rule costs them nothing: the lint suite is 90 passed, 1 skipped, with the live-tree test clean.
